root_cause: Claude MCP connector uses SSE transport (GET /sse → text/event-stream). Server was on StreamableHTTP only (POST /mcp + Mcp-Session-Id). Vercel serverless = stateless per request, so session state never persisted between tool calls.
fix: Added SSEServerTransport on GET /sse and POST /messages?sessionId=X alongside existing StreamableHTTP on POST /mcp

evidence.messages_404: expected — no active session in test

connector_action_required.action: Update T4H Remote MCP connector URL in claude.ai Settings → Integrations from /mcp to /sse
